theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_rc_af_polar_angle_fderiv
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (a e x : Euclid P), inner ℝ x a ≠ 0 → ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y : Euclid P => Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y a)) x ∧ ∀ v : Euclid P, fderiv ℝ (fun y : Euclid P => Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y a)) x v = inner ℝ (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a) v / (inner ℝ x a ^ 2 + inner ℝ x e ^ 2)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
